reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets have doubled since August 2026 (F-03) primarily because the billing import process is producing incorrect bill calculations - most plausibly from an unconfirmed August change to import validation rules (H-RULE-CHANGE-IMPORT-ERROR) - since the majority (59%) of disputed bills used ACTUAL, not estimated, meter reads (F-02), ruling out missing-read substitution as the main driver. A secondary driver is the drop in manual-read route completion to 88% against a 95% target (F-01), which plausibly accounts for the remaining 41% ESTIMATED-read disputes. Ticket response times remain within SLA (F-04) and no tariff change occurred (F-05), so slow ticket handling and tariff changes are not the cause.
